d:
Watch ‘Ennodu Nee Irundhaal’ from ‘I’ a painful love ballad sung by Sid Sriram & Sunitha Sarathy. A.R. Rahman takes Kabilan’s heart tugging lyrics and adds his melancholic magic to the number. The song is all about a lover wanting nothing but his lady love to be by his side. His yearning comes out beautifully in Sid Sriram’s voice and Kabilan’s words.
Song Name - Ennodu Nee Irundhaal
Movie - I
Singer - Sid Sriram & Sunitha Sarathy
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Kabilan
Director - Shankar
Starring - Vikram, Amy Jackson
